title: Repair a transaction-managed slide from its complete snapshot
preconditions: Use newSlideTransactionFixture, publish the initial complete slide and then commit a behavior change in service.go.

steps.action: Reconcile and inspect the evidence task; execute its query slide inspection route.
steps.expected_result: Route is query slide followed by apply-slide and repin; query returns the exact authoring snapshot from initial publication.

steps.action: Submit a complete desired slide update using that snapshot and changed exact code reference; reconcile again.
steps.expected_result: The update succeeds and stale currency is zero.

expected_result: The repair loop retains complete-slide concurrency guards.
